notes.title: Gameplay and QOL fixes
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly decreased the dad distribution rate in Dad Divisions
[*]Colliding into the rear wall in Endurodad and Dadathlon will no longer slow the player's movespeed
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes and Quality of Life updates[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where showering with the Wrong Dad in Dadathlon would sometimes ignore the volume setting
[*]Added more granularity to volume control options
[*]Reduced some flashing effects
[/list]

notes.title: ♫ Feliz Many Dads ♫
notes.content:
[h3] New game mode: Co-Pop [/h3]
------------------------------------
Head-to-head 2-player showering action! Battle it out with a friend to see who can shower with the their dads the fastest!

Play [b]local multiplayer[/b] (side by side on the same computer) OR
invite a friend/family member/boss/coworker to play [b]online[/b] with [b]Steam Remote Play Together[/b].

Supported Input Methods [list]
[*] Player 1 Keyboard (WASD/Arrows) or Gamepad
[*] Player 2 Keyboard (IJKL/Numpad) or Gamepad
[/list]
Notes [list]
[*] You may have to disconnect controllers if keyboard controls don't work in Co-Pop mode
[*] For MacOS clients playing remotely: You may need to move the "Steam Remote Play Together" configuration window to another screen/desktop.
[/list]

+ Added one new track to the OST

Previous versions of the game are also available by right clicking on the game in your library and selecting from "Properties > Betas"

notes.title: Back From the Store update
notes.content:
It's been... a few years. Got lost at the store in the milk aisle (they have a BUNCH of new ones if you haven't been in a while).

[b]General[/b]
- WASD Support! You're all grown up now!
- Gamepad and [b]Steam Deck[/b] support
- Steam cloud support for saves
- Reduced overall filesize

[b]Main Menu[/b]
- Fixed an issue where buttons would overlap eachother
- Slowed down flashing effects

[b]Endurodad & Dadathlon[/b]
- Fixed an issue where UI elements and puddles/wet floor signs were hidden behind powerup-related backgrounds
- Slowed down flashing effects on some powerups

[b]Dad Divisions[/b]
- Fixed gameover ending too soon (player had 1 less HP than intended)
- Lowered initial difficulty and smoothened Dad Distribution Rate (Dads Distribution will slowly speed up over time instead of all at once)

[b]Achievements[/b]
- Fixed "2 hours of shower" achievement accidentally unlocking under incorrect conditions [spoiler]Unlock hint: (Spend 2 hours in a Shower)[/spoiler]
- Due to popular demand, we've made "Find the real dad" achievement more difficult to unlock! It's now [i]divisively [/i]501+ times harder!

(The previous version of the game is also available under the 'classic' option under properties > beta)
